mechanism: insertArticle detects duplicates by letting the UNIQUE(feed_id, guid) constraint fail and catching the thrown exception ('Duplicate entry, ignore'). Every feed refresh re-attempts inserts for ALL previously seen articles — each one a full insert attempt that ends in a constraint-violation exception (statement execution + error object construction + catch), multiplying refresh cost with stored article count.
fix_summary: Inserts run with ConflictResolution.ON_CONFLICT_IGNORE so SQLite silently skips duplicates without exception overhead; behavior (only new articles stored) is unchanged.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
